title: HTTP 报文结构：请求行、头部、空行与主体
expected_output:
== 请求行 ==
method  = POST
target  = /v1/users
version = HTTP/1.1
== 头部 ==
host: api.example.com
content-type: application/json
content-length: 25
== 主体 ==
body = {"name":"cppcat","age":1}
body 字节数 = 25
与 Content-Length 一致: true

空行（CRLF CRLF）是头部与主体的分界符；解析器逐行读到空行即停止解析头部。
